== Format ==
*4on4 - Ladder
*Points per match played
** 1 point per map played
** 4 points per map win
** Points for completing challenges

=== Sign up ===
Your clan can either sign up by messaging {{player|'''Hooraytio#3070'''|flag=se|link=false}} on discord, or just agree to play a ladder prac with another clan and report the result in the <mark>#eql-ladder</mark> channel.

== Rules == 
* '''Prac procedure:''' Agree to play a ladder prac with another clan. Play as many maps as you like. You get 4 points for every map your clan wins, 1 activity point for every played map and whoever has the most points at the end of the season wins. For example, clan A prac vs clan B, they play 5 maps, clan A win 4 maps and clan B win 1 map, the final score is 21-9 for clan A. (4x4+5 & 1x4+5)

* '''Challenges:''' Bonus points are awarded to teams based on completed EQL SPL listed challenges. Bonus points are added to the points received from played maps. Claims of completed challenges must be made no later than season end date, with a supporting time stamped screenshot/.mvd uploaded in #eql-spl. New challenge proposals during season are most welcome, but must be listed on the Wiki before date of claim. Unless it's really awesome.  

* '''Clans and players:''' A clan can have any number of players. Members will not be listed. If the opponent does not agree with your line-up then find another opponent. You are allowed to create new clans and switch teams during the ladder.

* '''Maps:''' Any map is allowed, it is not up to the admin to decide which maps you want prac on. If the opponent doesnt agree with your pick then play another map or find another opponent.

* '''Stand-ins:''' You can use any standin you want as long as you can find an opponent who wants to play.

* '''Prac vs mix:''' Your clan can prac versus a mixed team, a mix team will be listed for statistical purposes but will not collect points.

* '''Server settings:''' Standard settings set by command /4on4

* '''Reporting:''' Report the game with screenshots in #eql-ladder
